title: Human subthalamic nucleus LFP during a stop-signal task (STN delta; Szabo et al.; derivative, 250 Hz)
description: Intraoperative local field potentials recorded with microelectrodes from the subthalamic nucleus of 13 patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation surgery while performing a stop-signal reaction time task. This derivative release provides the authors' continuous LFP, filtered and downsampled to 250 Hz (0.5 Hz high-pass version), repackaged in BIDS-iEEG format with events annotations. It supports analysis of delta-frequency processes in the human STN during action cancellation.
methods_description: Intraoperative STN microelectrode LFP recorded during DBS surgery while patients performed a stop-signal task. Original EEGLAB files at 250 Hz (high-pass 0.5 or 2 Hz, notch-filtered or cleaned) were converted to BrainVision float32 µV with unchanged values, and EEGLAB annotations were written to events.tsv.
